description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of tasks in an Android to-do list application. It manages binding task data to UI components, handles user interactions like toggling completion status and editing tasks, and maintains a map for category IDs to category names for richer display.

classes.name: TaskAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for managing and displaying a list of TaskEntity items in a RecyclerView, supporting item diffing and updates.

classes.name: TaskAdapter.TaskViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder encapsulating the views for a single task item.

methods.name: setCategoryNameMap
methods.description: Sets a map from category IDs to category names for display purposes.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item_task layout and creates a new TaskViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds task data to the views and sets up user interaction handlers.
